```{r}
#fmri data
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
tsv_files <- list.files("widsdatathon2025-university/train_tsv/train_tsv/", pattern = "\\.tsv$", full.names = TRUE)
extract_upper_tri <- function(file_path) {
  mat <- as.matrix(read_tsv(file_path, col_names = FALSE))
  upper_tri <- mat[upper.tri(mat, diag = FALSE)]  
  return(upper_tri)
}
patient_data <- t(sapply(tsv_files, extract_upper_tri))
patient_df <- as.data.frame(patient_data)
rownames(patient_df) <- basename(tsv_files)
library(tibble)
patient_df <- rownames_to_column(patient_df, var = "participant_id")
fmri <- patient_df
fmri$participant_id <- substr(fmri$participant_id, 5, 16)
fmri$participant_id <- sub("_.*", "", fmri$participant_id)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
#metadata
meta_train <- read.csv("widsdatathon2025-university/metadata/training_metadata.csv")
meta_test <- read.csv("widsdatathon2025-university/metadata/test_metadata.csv")
#missing values of meta_train
colSums(is.na(meta_train))
#class of meta_train
sapply(meta_train, class)
#data cleaning
library(dplyr)
#impute bmi by sex
bmi_means <- meta_train %>%
  group_by(sex) %>%
  summarise(bmi_mean = mean(bmi, na.rm = TRUE))
meta_train <- meta_train %>%
  left_join(bmi_means, by = "sex") %>%
  mutate(
    bmi = ifelse(is.na(bmi), bmi_mean, bmi)  
  ) %>%
  select(-bmi_mean) 
#turn NAs into Missing
meta_train <- meta_train %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.character), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), "Missing", .)))
library(dplyr)
num_cols <- names(meta_train)[sapply(meta_train, is.numeric)]
num_cols <- setdiff(num_cols, "age")
train_means <- sapply(meta_train[num_cols], mean, na.rm = TRUE)
train_sds   <- sapply(meta_train[num_cols], sd,   na.rm = TRUE)
meta_train <- meta_train %>%
  mutate(across(
    all_of(num_cols),
    ~ (. - train_means[cur_column()]) / train_sds[cur_column()]
  ))
#same for test data
meta_test <- meta_test %>%
  left_join(bmi_means, by = "sex") %>%
  mutate(
    bmi = ifelse(is.na(bmi), bmi_mean, bmi) 
  ) %>%
  select(-bmi_mean)  
meta_test <- meta_test %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.character), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), "Missing", .)))

cols_to_scale_test <- intersect(num_cols, names(meta_test))

meta_test <- meta_test %>%
  mutate(across(
    all_of(cols_to_scale_test),
    ~ (. - train_means[cur_column()]) / train_sds[cur_column()]
  ))

```

```{r}
library(caret)
columns_to_encode <- names(data)[sapply(data, is.character)]
columns_to_encode <- setdiff(columns_to_encode, "participant_id")
dummies <- dummyVars(~ ., data = data[, columns_to_encode, drop = FALSE], fullRank = TRUE)
onehot_matrix <- predict(dummies, newdata = data)
data2 <- bind_cols(
  data %>% select(participant_id, where(is.numeric)),
  as.data.frame(onehot_matrix)
)
```

#auto+XGboost(parameters tunning)
```{r}
library(keras)
library(caret)
library(xgboost)
library(tensorflow)

set.seed(123)
train_idx <- createDataPartition(data2$age, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)
train_set <- data2[train_idx, ]
test_set  <- data2[-train_idx, ]

fmri_cols <- names(data2)[2:(1 + 19901)]
X_train   <- as.matrix(train_set[, fmri_cols])
X_test    <- as.matrix(test_set[,  fmri_cols])
y_train   <- train_set$age
y_test    <- test_set$age

input_dim  <- ncol(X_train)
latent_dim <- 256


inputs  <- layer_input(shape = input_dim)
encoded <- inputs %>%
  layer_dense(units = 512, activation = "relu") %>%
  layer_dense(units = latent_dim, activation = "relu")
decoded <- encoded %>%
  layer_dense(units = 512, activation = "relu") %>%
  layer_dense(units = input_dim, activation = "linear")

autoencoder <- keras_model(inputs, decoded)
encoder     <- keras_model(inputs, encoded)

autoencoder %>% compile(
  optimizer = optimizer_adam(lr = 1e-3),
  loss      = "mse"
)
autoencoder %>% fit(
  X_train, X_train,
  epochs           = 50,
  batch_size       = 32,
  verbose          = 1
)

Z_train <- encoder %>% predict(X_train)
Z_test  <- encoder %>% predict(X_test)

train_df <- as.data.frame(Z_train)
colnames(train_df) <- paste0("Z", seq_len(ncol(train_df)))
train_df$age <- y_train

xgb_grid <- expand.grid(
  nrounds           = c(50, 100, 200),
  eta               = c(0.01, 0.03, 0.05, 0.1),
  max_depth         = c(3, 6, 9),
  gamma             = 0,
  colsample_bytree  = c(0.6, 0.8, 1.0),
  min_child_weight  = 1,
  subsample         = c(0.6, 0.8, 1.0)
)
tr_ctrl <- trainControl(
  method        = "cv",
  number        = 3,
  verboseIter   = TRUE,
  allowParallel = TRUE
)

set.seed(123)
xgb_tune <- caret::train(
  age ~ .,
  data      = train_df,
  method    = "xgbTree",
  trControl = tr_ctrl,
  tuneGrid  = xgb_grid,
  metric    = "RMSE"
)
print(xgb_tune$bestTune)

best <- xgb_tune$bestTune
dtrain <- xgb.DMatrix(data = Z_train, label = y_train)
dtest  <- xgb.DMatrix(data = Z_test,  label = y_test)

final_params <- list(
  objective        = "reg:squarederror",
  eta              = best$eta,
  max_depth        = best$max_depth,
  subsample        = best$subsample,
  colsample_bytree = best$colsample_bytree,
  gamma            = best$gamma,
  min_child_weight = best$min_child_weight,
  eval_metric      = "rmse"
)

model <- xgb.train(
  params  = final_params,
  data    = dtrain,
  nrounds = best$nrounds,
  verbose = 1
)

preds <- predict(model, dtest)
rmse  <- sqrt(mean((preds - y_test)^2))
sst   <- sum((y_test - mean(y_test))^2)
ssr   <- sum((preds - y_test)^2)
r2    <- 1 - ssr / sst

cat("Test RMSE:", round(rmse,4), "\n")
cat("Test R²:  ", round(r2,  4), "\n")
```
#autoencoder+lasso
```{r}
library(keras)
library(glmnet)
library(caret)

set.seed(42)

data_shuf <- data2[sample(nrow(data2)), ]
n <- nrow(data_shuf)
n_test <- floor(0.2 * n)
test_df <- data_shuf[1:n_test, ]
train_df <- data_shuf[(n_test+1):n, ]

fmri_cols <- names(data2)[2:19902]
meta_cols <- setdiff(names(data2), c("participant_id", fmri_cols, "age"))

X_fmri_train <- as.matrix(train_df[, fmri_cols])
X_fmri_test  <- as.matrix(test_df[,  fmri_cols])

input_dim <- ncol(X_fmri_train)
latent_dim <- 256

inputs <- layer_input(shape = input_dim)
encoded <- inputs %>%
  layer_dense(512, activation = "relu") %>%
  layer_dense(latent_dim, activation = "relu")
decoded <- encoded %>%
  layer_dense(512, activation = "relu") %>%
  layer_dense(input_dim, activation = "linear")

autoencoder <- keras_model(inputs, decoded)
encoder <- keras_model(inputs, encoded)

autoencoder %>% compile(
  optimizer = "adam",
  loss = "mse"
)

autoencoder %>% fit(
  x = X_fmri_train, y = X_fmri_train,
  epochs = 50, batch_size = 32,
  verbose = 1,
  callbacks = list(
    callback_early_stopping(monitor = "loss", patience = 5, restore_best_weights = TRUE)
  )
)

Z_train <- encoder %>% predict(X_fmri_train)
Z_test  <- encoder %>% predict(X_fmri_test)

X_train <- cbind(Z_train, train_df[, meta_cols])
X_test  <- cbind(Z_test,  test_df[, meta_cols])
y_train <- train_df$age
y_test  <- test_df$age

train_complete <- complete.cases(X_train, y_train)
test_complete  <- complete.cases(X_test, y_test)
X_train <- X_train[train_complete, ]
y_train <- y_train[train_complete]
X_test  <- X_test[test_complete, ]
y_test  <- y_test[test_complete]

cv_fit <- cv.glmnet(as.matrix(X_train), y_train, alpha = 1, nfolds = 5)
best_lambda <- cv_fit$lambda.min

model <- glmnet(as.matrix(X_train), y_train, alpha = 1, lambda = best_lambda)
preds <- predict(model, as.matrix(X_test))

rmse <- sqrt(mean((preds - y_test)^2))
r2 <- 1 - sum((y_test - preds)^2) / sum((y_test - mean(y_test))^2)

cat("Test RMSE:", round(rmse, 4), "\n")
cat("Test R²:  ", round(r2, 4), "\n")
```
#Autoencoder with elastic net
```{r}
library(keras)
library(caret)
library(glmnet)

set.seed(42)

data_shuf <- data2[sample(nrow(data2)), ]
n         <- nrow(data_shuf)
n_test    <- floor(0.2 * n)
test_df   <- data_shuf[1:n_test, ]
train_df  <- data_shuf[(n_test+1):n, ]

fmri_cols <- names(data2)[2:19902]
meta_cols <- setdiff(names(data2), c("participant_id", fmri_cols, "age"))

X_fmri_train <- as.matrix(train_df[, fmri_cols])
X_fmri_test  <- as.matrix(test_df[,  fmri_cols])
X_meta_train <- train_df[, meta_cols]
X_meta_test  <- test_df[,  meta_cols]
y_train      <- train_df$age
y_test       <- test_df$age

input_dim  <- ncol(X_fmri_train)
latent_dim <- 256

inputs <- layer_input(shape = input_dim)
encoded <- inputs %>%
  layer_dense(512, activation = "relu") %>%
  layer_dense(latent_dim, activation = "relu")
decoded <- encoded %>%
  layer_dense(512, activation = "relu") %>%
  layer_dense(input_dim, activation = "linear")

autoencoder <- keras_model(inputs, decoded)
encoder     <- keras_model(inputs, encoded)

autoencoder %>% compile(optimizer = "adam", loss = "mse")

autoencoder %>% fit(
  x = X_fmri_train, y = X_fmri_train,
  epochs = 50, batch_size = 32, verbose = 1,
  callbacks = list(
    callback_early_stopping(monitor = "loss", patience = 5, restore_best_weights = TRUE)
  )
)

Z_train <- encoder %>% predict(X_fmri_train)
Z_test  <- encoder %>% predict(X_fmri_test)

X_train <- cbind(Z_train, X_meta_train)
X_test  <- cbind(Z_test,  X_meta_test)

train_complete <- complete.cases(X_train, y_train)
test_complete  <- complete.cases(X_test,  y_test)
X_train <- X_train[train_complete, ]
y_train <- y_train[train_complete]
X_test  <- X_test[test_complete, ]
y_test  <- y_test[test_complete]

set.seed(42)
cv_fit <- cv.glmnet(as.matrix(X_train), y_train, alpha = 0.5, nfolds = 5)  # alpha=0.5 = Elastic Net
best_lambda <- cv_fit$lambda.min

model <- glmnet(as.matrix(X_train), y_train, alpha = 0.5, lambda = best_lambda)
preds <- predict(model, as.matrix(X_test))

rmse <- sqrt(mean((preds - y_test)^2))
r2   <- 1 - sum((y_test - preds)^2) / sum((y_test - mean(y_test))^2)

cat("Elastic Net Test RMSE:", round(rmse, 4), "\n")
cat("Elastic Net Test R²:  ", round(r2, 4), "\n")
```
# auto+elastic+para tunning
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(keras)
library(caret)
library(glmnet)

set.seed(42)

data_shuf <- data2[sample(nrow(data2)), ]
n         <- nrow(data_shuf)
n_test    <- floor(0.2 * n)
test_df   <- data_shuf[1:n_test, ]
train_df  <- data_shuf[(n_test+1):n, ]

fmri_cols <- names(data2)[2:19902]
meta_cols <- setdiff(names(data2), c("participant_id", fmri_cols, "age"))

X_fmri_train <- as.matrix(train_df[, fmri_cols])
X_fmri_test  <- as.matrix(test_df[,  fmri_cols])
X_meta_train <- train_df[, meta_cols]
X_meta_test  <- test_df[,  meta_cols]
y_train      <- train_df$age
y_test       <- test_df$age

param_grid <- expand.grid(
  latent_dim   = 256,
  hidden_units = 256,
  dropout      = 0
)

results <- data.frame()

for (i in 1:nrow(param_grid)) {
  cat("\n===== Running config", i, "=====\n")
  
  latent_dim   <- param_grid$latent_dim[i]
  hidden_units <- param_grid$hidden_units[i]
  dropout_rate <- param_grid$dropout[i]
  

  inputs <- layer_input(shape = ncol(X_fmri_train))
  encoded <- inputs %>%
    layer_dense(units = hidden_units, activation = "relu") %>%
    { if (dropout_rate > 0) layer_dropout(., rate = dropout_rate) else . } %>%
    layer_dense(units = latent_dim, activation = "relu")
  decoded <- encoded %>%
    layer_dense(units = hidden_units, activation = "relu") %>%
    layer_dense(units = ncol(X_fmri_train), activation = "linear")
  
  autoencoder <- keras_model(inputs, decoded)
  encoder     <- keras_model(inputs, encoded)
  
  autoencoder %>% compile(optimizer = "adam", loss = "mse")
  
  autoencoder %>% fit(
    x = X_fmri_train, y = X_fmri_train,
    epochs = 50, batch_size = 32, verbose = 0,
    callbacks = list(
      callback_early_stopping(monitor = "loss", patience = 5, restore_best_weights = TRUE)
    )
  )
  
  Z_train <- encoder %>% predict(X_fmri_train)
  Z_test  <- encoder %>% predict(X_fmri_test)
  X_train <- cbind(Z_train, X_meta_train)
  colnames(X_train) <- c(paste0("latent_", 1:ncol(Z_train)), names(X_meta_train))
  X_test  <- cbind(Z_test,  X_meta_test)
  
  train_complete <- complete.cases(X_train, y_train)
  test_complete  <- complete.cases(X_test,  y_test)
  X_train <- X_train[train_complete, ]
  y_train <- y_train[train_complete]
  X_test  <- X_test[test_complete, ]
  y_test  <- y_test[test_complete]
  
  #Elastic Net
  set.seed(42)
  cv_fit <- cv.glmnet(as.matrix(X_train), y_train, alpha = 0.5, nfolds = 5)
  best_lambda <- cv_fit$lambda.min
  
  model <- glmnet(as.matrix(X_train), y_train, alpha = 0.5, lambda = best_lambda)
  preds <- predict(model, as.matrix(X_test))
  
  #RMSE & R²
  rmse <- sqrt(mean((preds - y_test)^2))
  r2   <- 1 - sum((y_test - preds)^2) / sum((y_test - mean(y_test))^2)
  
  results <- rbind(
    results,
    data.frame(latent_dim, hidden_units, dropout_rate, rmse = round(rmse, 4), r2 = round(r2, 4))
  )
}

print(results)
library(glmnet)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

colnames(X_train) <- c(paste0("latent_", 1:ncol(Z_train)), names(X_meta_train))


cv_fit <- cv.glmnet(as.matrix(X_train), y_train, alpha = 0.5, nfolds = 5)
best_lambda <- cv_fit$lambda.min
model <- glmnet(as.matrix(X_train), y_train, alpha = 0.5, lambda = best_lambda)


coef_vec <- as.vector(coef(model))[-1]
feature_names <- colnames(X_train)
coef_df <- data.frame(
  Feature = feature_names,
  Coefficient = coef_vec,
  abs_coef = abs(coef_vec)
)

```

#Autoencoder with lasso, ridge and Elastic net
```{r}
library(keras)
library(caret)
library(glmnet)
library(nloptr)

set.seed(42)

data_shuf <- data2[sample(nrow(data2)), ]
n         <- nrow(data_shuf)
n_test    <- floor(0.2 * n)
test_df   <- data_shuf[1:n_test, ]
train_df  <- data_shuf[(n_test + 1):n, ]

fmri_cols <- names(data2)[2:19902]
meta_cols <- setdiff(names(data2), c("participant_id", fmri_cols, "age"))

X_fmri_train <- as.matrix(train_df[, fmri_cols])
X_fmri_test  <- as.matrix(test_df[,  fmri_cols])
X_meta_train <- train_df[, meta_cols]
X_meta_test  <- test_df[,  meta_cols]
y_train <- train_df$age
y_test  <- test_df$age

latent_dim   <- 256
hidden_units <- 128
dropout_rate <- 0.0

inputs <- layer_input(shape = ncol(X_fmri_train))
encoded <- inputs %>%
  layer_dense(units = hidden_units, activation = "relu") %>%
  { if (dropout_rate > 0) layer_dropout(., rate = dropout_rate) else . } %>%
  layer_dense(units = latent_dim, activation = "relu")
decoded <- encoded %>%
  layer_dense(units = hidden_units, activation = "relu") %>%
  layer_dense(units = ncol(X_fmri_train), activation = "linear")

autoencoder <- keras_model(inputs, decoded)
encoder     <- keras_model(inputs, encoded)

autoencoder %>% compile(optimizer = "adam", loss = "mse")

autoencoder %>% fit(
  x = X_fmri_train, y = X_fmri_train,
  epochs = 50, batch_size = 32, verbose = 0,
  callbacks = list(callback_early_stopping(monitor = "loss", patience = 5, restore_best_weights = TRUE))
)

Z_train <- encoder %>% predict(X_fmri_train)
Z_test  <- encoder %>% predict(X_fmri_test)
X_train <- cbind(Z_train, X_meta_train)
X_test  <- cbind(Z_test,  X_meta_test)

train_complete <- complete.cases(X_train, y_train)
test_complete  <- complete.cases(X_test,  y_test)
X_train <- X_train[train_complete, ]
y_train <- y_train[train_complete]
X_test  <- X_test[test_complete, ]
y_test  <- y_test[test_complete]

ridge_cv  <- cv.glmnet(as.matrix(X_train), y_train, alpha = 0,   nfolds = 5)
lasso_cv  <- cv.glmnet(as.matrix(X_train), y_train, alpha = 1,   nfolds = 5)
enet_cv   <- cv.glmnet(as.matrix(X_train), y_train, alpha = 0.5, nfolds = 5)

ridge_pred <- predict(ridge_cv, newx = as.matrix(X_test), s = "lambda.min")
lasso_pred <- predict(lasso_cv, newx = as.matrix(X_test), s = "lambda.min")
enet_pred  <- predict(enet_cv,  newx = as.matrix(X_test),  s = "lambda.min")

rmse_loss <- function(w, y_true, preds_list) {
  pred <- w[1]*preds_list[[1]] + w[2]*preds_list[[2]] + w[3]*preds_list[[3]]
  sqrt(mean((y_true - pred)^2))
}

eval_g_eq <- function(w, y_true, preds_list) sum(w) - 1

opt <- nloptr::nloptr(
  x0          = rep(1/3, 3),
  eval_f      = rmse_loss,
  lb          = c(0, 0, 0),
  ub          = c(1, 1, 1),
  eval_g_eq   = eval_g_eq,
  opts        = list("algorithm" = "NLOPT_LN_COBYLA", "xtol_rel" = 1e-6),
  y_true      = y_test,
  preds_list  = list(ridge_pred, lasso_pred, enet_pred)
)

opt_weights <- opt$solution
ensemble_pred <- opt_weights[1]*ridge_pred + opt_weights[2]*lasso_pred + opt_weights[3]*enet_pred

rmse <- sqrt(mean((y_test - ensemble_pred)^2))
r2   <- 1 - sum((y_test - ensemble_pred)^2) / sum((y_test - mean(y_test))^2)

cat("Optimized Weighted Ensemble RMSE:", round(rmse, 4), "\n")
cat("Optimized Weighted Ensemble R²:  ", round(r2,   4), "\n")
cat("Weights: ridge =", round(opt_weights[1], 3),
    ", lasso =", round(opt_weights[2], 3),
    ", elastic =", round(opt_weights[3], 3), "\n")
```
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(gridExtra)
enet_resid <- as.vector(y_test - enet_pred)
enet_fitted <- as.vector(enet_pred)

df_resid <- data.frame(Fitted = enet_fitted, Residual = enet_resid)


p1 <- ggplot(df_resid, aes(x = Fitted, y = Residual)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  labs(title = "Residual Plot", x = "Predicted Age", y = "Residual (True - Predicted)") +
  theme_minimal()

df_qq <- data.frame(resid = enet_resid)
p2 <- ggplot(df_qq, aes(sample = resid)) +
  stat_qq() +
  stat_qq_line(color = "red") +
  labs(title = "QQ Plot of Residuals") +
  theme_minimal()


grid.arrange(p1, p2, ncol = 2)
```
